system.description:
Make a Spellcasting Roll (15) to embody an aspect of Eliodd. The embodiment lasts until the next rest or you take Severe damage. You may mark a Stress to change between aspects.

  • Aspect of the Warrior. When you succeed with Fear, you may clear a Stress.
  • Aspect of the Poet. When the GM spends a Fear, you may mark a Stress to gain a Hope.
  • Aspect of the King. When an ally rolls with Hope, you may mark a Stress to also gain a Hope.
